about.title: About Total Pool Care
text: At Total Pool Care, we believe every backyard pool should be a source of pride, relaxation, and fun, not stress. That’s why homeowners across The Woodlands, Magnolia, Montgomery, Conroe, Willis, Tomball, and beyond trust us for dependable weekly pool service, expert pool repairs, and high-quality equipment upgrades.

Whether your pool needs a quick green-to-clean transformation, a saltwater conversion, or the convenience of WiFi pool automation, our licensed team makes it happen on time, on budget, and with a smile.
We live and work right here in Montgomery County. You’re more than just a customer; you’re part of our community.
